description: Bitcoin and Ethereum trend signal (LONG or CASH per sleeve, 50-day trend gates, BTC 200-day master gate) on the newest completed UTC daily close, evaluated every calendar day including weekends and stamped with the close used (one close ahead of the free tier). Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_crypto_trend_live
